record.reason: Adaptive Token Sampling inserts a parameter-free module into vision transformers that scores tokens by class-token attention and samples a per-image token count, halving GFLOPs on ImageNet/video classification; it is token-reduction for ViT inference efficiency, but the target is vision classification rather than LLM inference.
record.title: Adaptive Inverse Transform Sampling For Efficient Vision Transformers
